title: Diarization engine and speaker-to-segment assignment
description: Find who spoke when in a finished recording using sherpa-onnx's offline diarization, and map those turns to transcript segments (goal 2). The mapping logic is pure Kotlin and unit-tested.
steps: Create `diarization/SpeakerTurn.kt`: `data class SpeakerTurn(val startMs: Long, val endMs: Long, val speaker: Int)`.

Create `diarization/Diarizer.kt`: `interface Diarizer : Closeable { fun diarize(samples: FloatArray, numSpeakers: Int, threshold: Float, onProgress: (Float) -> Unit): List<SpeakerTurn> }` and `fun interface DiarizerFactory { fun create(): Diarizer }`.

Create `engine/sherpa/SherpaDiarizer.kt`: `class SherpaDiarizer(segmentationModel: File, embeddingModel: File, numThreads: Int) : Diarizer`. Build `OfflineSpeakerDiarization(assetManager = null, config = OfflineSpeakerDiarizationConfig(segmentation = OfflineSpeakerSegmentationModelConfig(pyannote = OfflineSpeakerSegmentationPyannoteModelConfig(model = segmentationModel.absolutePath), numThreads = numThreads), embedding = SpeakerEmbeddingExtractorConfig(model = embeddingModel.absolutePath, numThreads = numThreads), clustering = FastClusteringConfig(numClusters = -1, threshold = 0.5f), minDurationOn = 0.3f, minDurationOff = 0.5f))`. In `diarize`, call `sd.setConfig(sd.config.copy(clustering = FastClusteringConfig(numClusters = numSpeakers, threshold = threshold)))`, then `sd.processWithCallback(samples, callback = { done, total, _ -> onProgress(done.toFloat() / total); 0 })` and map each `OfflineSpeakerDiarizationSegment(start, end, speaker, ...)` (seconds) to `SpeakerTurn((start*1000).toLong(), (end*1000).toLong(), speaker)`. `close()` calls `sd.release()`.

Create `engine/sherpa/SherpaDiarizerFactory.kt` (`class SherpaDiarizerFactory(store: ModelStore, settings: SettingsRepository) : DiarizerFactory`) using `ModelCatalog.SEGMENTATION` file `model.int8.onnx` and `ModelCatalog.EMBEDDING` file `wespeaker_en_voxceleb_resnet34_LM.onnx` via `store.fileFor`, `numThreads` from settings; throw `IllegalStateException("Model not installed: <id>")` if missing. Add `val diarizerFactory: DiarizerFactory = SherpaDiarizerFactory(modelStore, settingsRepository)` to `AppContainer`.

Create `diarization/SpeakerAssigner.kt`: `data class SegmentSpan(val id: Long, val startMs: Long, val endMs: Long)`, `data class Assignment(val speakerBySegment: Map<Long, Int?>, val speakerCount: Int)`, `object SpeakerAssigner { fun assign(segments: List<SegmentSpan>, turns: List<SpeakerTurn>): Assignment }`. Rules: (1) for each segment, total overlap ms per speaker across turns; pick the max; ties -> the speaker whose overlapping turn starts first. (2) No overlap -> the speaker of the nearest turn if its gap (distance between intervals) ≤ 1000 ms, else null. (3) Renumber speakers in order of first appearance in the segment list (by segment startMs): first seen becomes 0, next 1, … ; speakerCount = number of distinct assigned speakers. Turns not overlapping any segment do not count.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: segment 0–1000 with turns (0–600 spk 1, 600–1000 spk 0) -> speaker of spk 1 renumbered to 0
Test: two segments, raw speakers 3 then 1 -> assigned 0 then 1, speakerCount 2
Test: segment 5000–6000 with nearest turn ending at 4500 -> that speaker; nearest turn ending at 3500 -> null
Test: equal overlap tie goes to the turn that starts first
Test: empty turns -> all null, speakerCount 0
`source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` exits 0
notes: sherpa classes used (package `com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx`, v1.13.8): OfflineSpeakerDiarization(assetManager, config) with `config` val, `setConfig`, `processWithCallback(samples, callback: (Int, Int, Long) -> Int, arg = 0)`, `release()`; OfflineSpeakerDiarizationConfig(segmentation, embedding, clustering, minDurationOn, minDurationOff); OfflineSpeakerSegmentationModelConfig(pyannote, numThreads, debug, provider); OfflineSpeakerSegmentationPyannoteModelConfig(model, windowShiftRatio); SpeakerEmbeddingExtractorConfig(model, numThreads, debug, provider); FastClusteringConfig(numClusters, threshold, computeConfidence). The callback must return 0 to continue. | Always: run `source scripts/env.sh` before Gradle; the verify command is `source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug`; run `./gradlew --stop` before ending. Never instantiate `com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx` classes in unit tests and only reference them inside package `com.convoscribe.engine.sherpa`. Source root: `app/src/main/java/com/convoscribe/`, tests: `app/src/test/java/com/convoscribe/`.
